name: How often does a log cabin need to be refinished?

mainEntity.name: How often does a log cabin need to be refinished?

acceptedAnswer.text: Exterior log cabin refinishing is typically recommended every three to five years, though interior logs last much longer. The exact timeframe depends on your cabin's sun exposure, moisture levels, and the quality of the prior finish. South- and west-facing walls usually show clear coat failure and sun bleaching earlier than shaded walls. Watch for signs like peeling stain, water soaking into the wood instead of beading up, or dull, graying patches. When HH Remodeling evaluates a log home, owner Abraham Becerra assesses whether a maintenance coat is sufficient or if the surface requires complete stripping down to bare timber before new finish can adhere properly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Exterior logs generally require refinishing every three to five years, depending on sun and moisture exposure. Interior logs last significantly longer without full refinishing.
